It's not justice, when women are regarded as liars. 

It's not consent, when women are afraid to say no. 

It's not free speech, when women are silenced. 

It's not human rights, when women are unprotected. 

It's not rocket science, why women have had enough. 

#MeToo

Stop calling women attention seeking liars. 

Start asking, why this pandemic of violence against women is still largely ignored. 

Start asking, why women are humiliated when we do report. 

Start asking, why most cases are never even investigated. 

Enough is enough. 

#MeToo
